text_block_list.text:
One day, after safely finishing her Debut and proceeding
with training focused primarily on physical conditioning—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Yaaah!

Unlike the powerful running style of her older sister Verxina, Vivlos has a charm all her own.
She is bound to grow by leaps and bounds in the future.
choice_data_list: (That is, once I'm in better shape, though.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Good afternoon, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion during your practice.
Would it be all right if I observed my little sister for a bit?
I started to feel a little nervous. While she shows the face of an older sister in front of Verxina, facing her directly like this radiates an overwhelming aura.

Verxina finished all three Tiara races
in 2nd place behind Gentildonna.
The frustrating moments continued in her subsequent races as well.

However, she didn't give up.
Shaking off the shadow of "2nd place" etched into her,
she went on to claim a brilliant GⅠ victory in the Victoria Mile—

The following year, she went on to win that same race back-to-back.
Her indomitable spirit, having swept away the shadows of defeat to become queen, moved the hearts of countless fans.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective, Trainer,
how did my little sister's run look?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I see.
I... feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even when we ran together as children...
I could always sense her talent.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure she will achieve
wonderful results in high-level races."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Even on the Tiara route.

There's a sense of inner conflict in the way Verxina speaks.
Surely, there's something she wants to convey, but...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...To be honest, I am worried.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If she runs the Tiara route, she'll
inevitably be compared to me."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That girl will end up shouldering the burden
of what I failed to accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Had I won,
things might have turned out differently, though."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis! / Big brother!
Did you come to watch me?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes,
I wanted to see how your running was looking.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Sis...
Why the long face?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Do you think so?
I'm sure it's just your imagination.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! 
That's definitely weird!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you're feeling down in the dumps,
it's best to go all out and have a blast, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Trainy, training's only in the morning today, right?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then once we're done...
let's all go out together, okay?

And so, thanks to a sudden plea from
Vivlos, we all ended up at the amusement
park together right after practice.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis!
I wanna ride the teacups together!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay? 
Aren't you going to get dizzy?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I won't spin them around like that!
Please! ♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, all right.
Shall we get going, then?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Roger that!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy, could you take a video for me?
Ah, and one for UmaSta too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's go!
Big Sis♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes—

Verxina shows her affection to Vivlos, who is pampering herself to her heart's content.
Whenever you see them, they're always the best of friends.
choice_data_list: (Because she cares so much, she can't help but worry...)
(Because she cares so much, she can't help but worry...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, looks like we're running low on drinks.
I'll go buy some.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, you should rest, Trainer.
My girl must have run you ragged, haven't she?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, it wasn't even that bad, was it?
It was just a few thrill rides in a row, right?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Is riding the roller coaster 5 times in a row
really just 'a little bit'?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm off.
Wait for me a bit, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay, have fun!
...Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
'Cause I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking how nice it is that I can
hang out normally like this with you again.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Because Big Sis has been super busy with racing this whole time."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Besides...
it really wasn't the kind of atmosphere where you could say "Let's play~♪"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Especially during the Triple Tiara races...
Big Sis looked like she was having such a hard time.

—Three Tiara route races, all 2nd-place finishes.
That itself is an amazing record. But...
Verxina must not have been satisfied with that.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis worked so hard.
That's why she was super strong!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Still, I couldn't beat Gentildonna-san...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: After the final Shuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Verxina.
I'm such a hopeless big sister."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The final jewel of the crown. If nothing else, at least that...
At least that, I wanted to make mine."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "I'm sorry I couldn't be a strong, cool big sister..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...And yet, my big sis was so cool back then."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you like that, isn't it only natural
to think, 'Well then, I will!'?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm not Big Sis.
But I'm one of only two little sisters in the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If I win the Triple Tiara,
Big Sis will definitely be happy.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I want to do something "for Big Sister"!

It seems Vivlos understands well
what Verxina is worried about.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want to show the Triple Tiara
to my big sister!
That's why... that's why...!
choice_data_list: ...Let's do our best for next year!
...Let's do our best for next year!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's it!
I'll do my best――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Oof.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
My tummy feels kinda...
Gotta run to the restroom~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I wonder if it'll be all right.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes.
...Right as that girl was speaking.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...You've really...
been watching me closely all this time, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos has her own way of thinking. She's not just a child chasing after others anymore.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Once again, please take good care of that girl—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Noooo waaaay!
I don't wanna go home yet~~~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Still, your stomach hurts, right? In that case, you really should go home and get some proper rest."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Still, after all this...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...You can just come visit again soon.
With Cheval next time.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I imagine you'll be quite busy from now on, but... feel free to invite me anytime. I'll come right over.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup.
I loooove you, Big Sis♡
